trans.sense: to move in an energetic trot
to move in an energetic trot

examples.text:
c. 1593, John Donne, Satire I,
Now leaps he upright, Joggs me, and cryes: Do you see
Yonder well favoured youth? Oh, ’tis hee
That dances so divinely

When now was wasted more than half the night,
And the stars faded at approaching light;
Sudden I jogg’d Ulysses, who was laid
Fast by my side, and shiv’ring thus I said.

glosses: To push slightly; to move or shake with a push or jerk, as to gain the attention of; to jolt.

examples.text: I tried desperately to jog my memory.
Jog on, jog on, the foot-path way.

Here lieth one who did most truly prove,
That he could never die while he could move,

While he might still jogg on and keep his trot,

When we had towed about four Days more, our Gunner, who was our Pilot, begun to observe that we did not keep our right Course so exactly as we ought, the River winding away a little towards the North, and gave us Notice accordingly. However, we were not willing to lose the Advantage of Water-Carriage, at least not till we were forced to it; so we jogg’d on, and the River served us about Threescore Miles further […]

That fiery doctor who had hailed me friend,
Did it because my by-paths, once proved wrong
And beaconed properly, would commend again
The good old ways our sires jogged safely o’er,
Though not their squeamish sons; […]

raw_glosses: (intransitive) To walk or ride forward with a jolting pace; to move at a heavy pace, trudge; to move on or along.
glosses: To walk or ride forward with a jolting pace; to move at a heavy pace, trudge; to move on or along.

examples.text: I saw her jogging in the forest yesterday.

raw_glosses: (exercise, intransitive) To move at a pace between walking and running, to run at a leisurely pace.
glosses: To move at a pace between walking and running, to run at a leisurely pace.

raw_glosses: (transitive) To cause to move at an energetic trot.
glosses: To cause to move at an energetic trot.

raw_glosses: (transitive) To straighten stacks of paper by lightly tapping against a flat surface.
glosses: To straighten stacks of paper by lightly tapping against a flat surface.

examples.text: His jogging of my memory helped me recall what happened that day.

glosses: The action of the verb to jog.
The practice of running at a relatively slow pace for exercise.
